evidence.name: Screen field: Entrance easing
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Entrance easing" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Entrance easing
sections.description: Shapes how the entrance speeds up and slows down. The default, Ease Out, starts quickly and settles gently; Ease Out Back adds a slight overshoot, and Linear moves at a constant speed. It sits under Advanced and only appears while Screen Entrance is on, and most screens can keep the default.
